entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your order number?

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Aero Helmet. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color. It's not what I thought it would be. It's fine, I just don't want it anymore.
I understand completely. Sometimes the shades can vary a bit from what you see on screen. Is the item still in its original packaging?
Yeah, the box unopened. I didn't even bother with it once I saw the color through the little window. It's not a safety issue or anything like that.
Okay, perfect. Let me just check the policy here... I see the delivery was 68 days ago. Our return window is 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe.
So you can take it back?

Absolutely. Since the helmet is new and the box unopened, I can process this return for you right now. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. You just need to print it, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at the post office.
Fine. And I get a full refund?
Yes, of course. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll process a full refund to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.
Whatever. About time something was simple. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
